seoTitle: How to Use Nectar Points on eBay Under the New Rules
metaDescription: Learn how to link your Nectar account to eBay, check your points balance, and redeem points at checkout under the updated redemption rules.
intro: Nectar points can be applied toward eBay purchases once your account is linked, but the updated rules affect eligibility, thresholds, and how points combine with other offers. This guide explains linking your account, checking your balance, and redeeming points during checkout.

steps.heading: Link your Nectar account to eBay
steps.body: Connect your Nectar account through eBay's website or mobile app so your points become available for redemption.

steps.heading: Check your point balance
steps.body: View your current Nectar balance before shopping so you know how much value you have available to apply.

steps.heading: Apply points during checkout
steps.body: At checkout, select the option to apply Nectar points toward your purchase, either partially or in full depending on your balance.

steps.heading: Meet the minimum spend requirement
steps.body: Be aware of the minimum spend threshold required before points can be redeemed on an order.

steps.heading: Combine points with coupons or sales
steps.body: Check whether Nectar points can be combined with eBay coupons or ongoing sale offers to maximize your savings.

steps.heading: Track expiry and manage points
steps.body: Keep an eye on point expiry dates and track your balance regularly so you don't lose value before you can use it.

faq.question: How do I link my Nectar account to eBay?
faq.answer: You can link your Nectar account through eBay's website or mobile app in your account settings.

faq.question: Is there a minimum spend to use Nectar points on eBay?
faq.answer: Yes, the updated rules include a minimum spend requirement before points can be applied at checkout.

faq.question: Can I combine Nectar points with eBay coupons?
faq.answer: In many cases you can combine points with eBay coupons or sale offers, though it's worth checking the current terms.

faq.question: Do Nectar points expire?
faq.answer: Yes, Nectar points can expire, so it's important to track your balance and expiry dates to avoid losing value.

faq.question: Can I use partial points on a purchase?
faq.answer: Yes, you can typically apply either partial or full points toward an eligible order at checkout.
